headline: Renesas posts Senior Principal roles to lead automotive PMIC mixed-signal verification methodology
fact: Renesas posted related Senior Principal verification roles in Chandler and Plano for its Automotive PMIC product line. The descriptions cover architecture of mixed-signal environments with RNM and AMS model integration, RTL-to-GLS correlation, PVT analysis, debugging of switched-mode regulators and LDOs, handoffs with ATE and Silicon Validation, mentoring and verification-methodology definition, and continuous improvement of verification infrastructure. The role descriptions also call for driving verification strategy across multiple product platforms and evaluating emerging verification technologies and AI-based solutions.
